deterministic_reproducibility.this_phase: No new counts were computed. Existing TOKEN-03 saved counts were read only as persisted evidence fields.
deterministic_reproducibility.future_pair_rule: Baseline and adaptive rows must use the same accounting_version, tokenizer_name, tokenizer_version, counted_spans_policy_id, normalization_policy_id, redaction policy and evidence class. Mixed heuristic/exact accounting fails the pair.
deterministic_reproducibility.future_recompute_requirement: If counts are recomputed later, the runner must name the exact tokenizer implementation/ref and persist per-span refs, hashes and token counts before any comparison math is accepted.

limitations: Heuristic word/punctuation accounting is an estimate, not a vendor model tokenizer.
No complete pair exists in this phase, so no baseline-vs-adaptive token delta is computed.
Quality non-regression remains required before any savings claim in a later phase.
